_about: Maintainers: the rules of the seeded chain (node labs/start.mjs sync-seeds). harnessPaths: what `bring` carries forward from earlier levels. Per level: local = files that don't pass to the next level; keep = starter files `bring` never overwrites; overrides = inherited files this level's starter changes on purpose; drop = inherited files this level must not have; _why = a sentence explaining the level's rules.

lab-00/medium._why: Think first plans a new feature, so it starts with the red build already fixed (hasPassed checks the exam grade too).

lab-02/easy._why: The README gets a Modules list: the new-module recipe adds a line to it.

lab-05/easy._why: From this lab on, the guard writes audit logs to .agent-logs/, which can hold secrets: .gitignore keeps them out of commits (and still ignores mcp/state.json), so the line belongs to the harness the learner owns. AGENTS.md gains the boundary "Never change the guardrails in .github/hooks/".
